entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know that I should hold[n]back feelings like this,[n]given our situation...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But it's Christmas Eve. I want[n]to spend it together with you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you think we could walk[n]around the city a bit... and[n]then head back to your room?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm over in Shibuya now. Let's[n]meet up in front of the station.
